nodes.label: Real Estate OnTheMarket (core module)
nodes.rationale: Kept independent of the portal-reporting module so a single portal integration can be added or removed without touching shared reporting; provider credentials and transport are pushed into replaceable integration services rather than the core.

nodes.label: Provider-neutral portal integration boundary
nodes.rationale: Portal-specific sync cores stay independent of shared reporting, and credentials/transport live in replaceable integration services, so a portal vendor change is contained to one package.
